title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Packers D/ST picks up two interceptions in Week 6
items.desc: The Packers D/ST allowed 13 points while notching two interceptions and one sack in a 23-13 win over the Cowboys in Week 6.
items.impact: Green Bay's defense was solid in the win, holding Dallas scoreless in the first half. They got interceptions from Evan Williams and Brandon Cisse while Lukas Van Ness provided the sack. The Packers will take on the Lions in Week 7.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Trey Smack hits three FGs in Week 6
items.desc: Trey Smack made all three of his field goals while adding two extra points in a 23-13 win over the Cowboys in Week 6.
items.impact: Smack hit field goals from 25, 44, and 29 yards out to help propel the Packers to the win over Dallas. The rookie has now made 10 of his 13 field-goal attempts while hitting 11 extra points this year. He will take on the Lions in Week 7.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Tucker Kraft catches five passes in Week 6
items.desc: Tucker Kraft caught five of his eight targets for 37 yards in a 23-13 win over the Cowboys in Week 6.
items.impact: Kraft finished tied for second on the team in targets but was able to manage just 37 yards in the win. The veteran tight end now has 25 catches for 249 yards and one touchdown in six games for the Packers this year. He will be a strong TE1 in Week 7 vs. the Lions.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Matthew Golden leads Packers in Week 6
items.desc: Matthew Golden caught six of his 13 targets for 104 yards and a touchdown in a 23-13 win over the Cowboys in Week 6.
items.impact: Golden led the Packers in all receiving categories in the win. His touchdown came on a nine-yard pass from Jordan Love in the first quarter. Golden has broken out in year No. 2, posting 30 catches for 501 yards and three touchdowns in six games. He will be a strong fantasy option in Week 7 vs. the Lions.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Christian Watson goes for 64 yards in Week 6
items.desc: Christian Watson caught three of his eight targets for 64 yards in a 23-13 win over the Cowboys in Week 6.
items.impact: Watson was mostly held in check by the Dallas defense, doing most of his damage on a 28-yard reception. The veteran wideout is enjoying a big season, catching 29 passes for 538 yards and six touchdowns through six games. He will be a low-end WR1 in Week 7's potential shootout vs. the Lions.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Kaleb Johnson sees just one carry in Week 6
items.desc: Kaleb Johnson lost two yards on his lone carry in a 23-13 win over the Cowboys in Week 6.
items.impact: Johnson was an afterthought in the Green Bay offense with Pierre Strong Jr. seeing 11 carries and MarShawn Lloyd handling 10. The veteran can be dropped in all leagues heading into Week 7's matchup vs. the Lions.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Pierre Strong Jr. leads Green Bay backfield in Week 6
items.desc: Pierre Strong Jr. carried the ball 11 times for 28 yards and caught five of his six targets for 39 yards in a 23-13 win over the Cowboys in Week 6.
items.impact: Strong led the Green Bay backfield in the win. The veteran has now played two games for the Packers, posting 35 rushing yards while catching eight passes for 50 yards. He is now looking like the running back to roster in Green Bay, at least until Josh Jacobs returns. Strong will face off against the Lions in Week 7.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: MarShawn Lloyd held to 10 yards in Week 6 win
items.desc: MarShawn Lloyd carried the ball eight times for 10 yards and failed to catch his lone target in a 23-13 win over the Cowboys in Week 6.
items.impact: LLoyd scored two touchdowns in Week 5 but he took a backseat to Pierre Strong against Dallas. The veteran has now rushed 48 times for just 122 yards and two touchdowns while adding 10 catches for 55 yards and a score through six games. He will be tough to trust, even as a flex option, in Week 7 vs. the Lions.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Jordan Love throws one TD, rushes for another in Week 6 win
items.desc: Jordan Love completed 23 of his 41 passes for 276 yards, one touchdown, and one interception while adding four rushes for 12 yards and a touchdown in a 23-13 win over the Cowboys in Week 6.
items.impact: Love connected with Matthew Golden for a nine-yard touchdown in the first quarter and then rushed for a one-yard TD in the second. The veteran quarterback is putting together a strong season, passing for 1,684 yards, 11 touchdowns, and four interceptions through six games. He will be on the QB1 radar in Week 7 vs. the Lions.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Cowboys D/ST allows 23 points in Week 6
items.desc: The Cowboys D/ST allowed 23 points while picking up three sacks and forcing one turnover in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
items.impact: Dallas had a tough time slowing the Packers down, although they did tighten up after halftime, allowing just two field goals in the second half. They got an interception from Dee Winters, while Quinnen Williams, Elijah Garcia, and Kenny Clark provided the sacks. The Cowboys will now prepare to face the Eagles in Week 7.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Brandon Aubrey held to one XP in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Brandon Aubrey did not attempt a field goal while hitting his lone extra point in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
items.impact: Aubrey was held without a field-goal attempt for the second time this season as Dallas really struggled to move the ball on offense against Green Bay, especially in the first half. Aubrey has now hit nine of his 12 field goals and added 14 extra points this season. He will look to bounce back against the Eagles in Week 7.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Jake Ferguson held to two catches in Week 6
items.desc: Jake Ferguson caught two of his three targets for 13 yards in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
items.impact: Ferguson was held in check by the Packers in the loss as the Cowboys leaned on CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens in the passing attack. Ferguson is putting together a pedestrian season, posting just 17 catches for 115 yards and three touchdowns in six games. He will be a high-end TE2 in Week 7 vs. Philadelphia.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: KaVontae Turpin injures hamstring in Week 6 loss
items.desc: KaVontae Turpin injured his ribs on the opening kickoff in Sunday night's 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
items.impact: Turpin returned the opening kickoff 25 yards before the injury. He went for X-rays, which came back negative, as Tyler Goodson replaced him as the team's return man. For now, the Pro Bowl returner can be considered questionable for his team's Week 7 matchup against the Eagles.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Ryan Flournoy finds the end zone in Week 6
items.desc: Ryan Flournoy caught seven of his nine targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
items.impact: Flournoy turned in a solid game while operating as the Cowboys' No. 3 receiver. He caught Dak Prescott's lone touchdown on a six-yard pass with 44 seconds left in the contest. Flournoy now has 23 catches for 234 yards and one touchdown through six contests this year. He will be a decent flex in fantasy in Week 7 vs. the Eagles.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: George Pickens goes for 73 yards in Week 6
items.desc: George Pickens caught six of his 11 targets for 73 yards in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
items.impact: Pickens was held in check in the first half as he had just a 16-yard catch going into halftime. The veteran wideout ultimately wound up leading the Cowboys in receiving yardage in the loss. Pickens now has 33 catches for 428 yards and one touchdown through six games. He will be a WR2 in fantasy in Week 7 vs. the Eagles.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: CeeDee Lamb goes for 70 yards in Week 6
items.desc: CeeDee Lamb caught nine of his 18 targets for 70 yards in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
items.impact: Lamb drew an impressive number of targets but was inefficient with the workload, catching just half of them while averaging just 7.8 yards per catch. The veteran wideout now has 48 catches for 577 yards and four touchdowns through six games. He will be a high-end WR1 in fantasy in Week 7 vs. the Eagles.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Tyler Goodson catches one pass in Week 6
items.desc: Tyler Goodson gained zero yards on two carries while catching his lone target for a nine-yard gain in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
items.impact: Goodson was quiet while mixing in behind starter Javonte Williams in the loss. The veteran running back should continue to be treated as nothing more than a handcuff in fantasy moving forward.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Javonte Williams finds the end zone in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Javonte Williams carried the ball 11 times for 41 yards and a touchdown while catching both of his targets for nine yards in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
items.impact: Williams was held to a season-low 11 carries with the Cowboys falling behind 17-0 at halftime. The veteran still managed to find the end zone, giving him eight all-purpose scores through six games. He will remain a locked-in RB1 in fantasy heading into Week 7 vs. the Eagles.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Dak Prescott throws one TD in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Dak Prescott completed 34 of his 54 passes for 258 yards, one touchdown, and two interceptions while adding two rushes for seven yards in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
items.impact: Prescott and the Cowboys were shut out by the Packers in the first half before showing some life after halftime. The veteran's lone TD pass went to Ryan Flournoy with 44 seconds left in the contest. Prescott survived an injury scare in the first half as he took a huge hit after a pass attempt and appeared to be favoring his ribs. He ultimately didn't miss any time in the game, but it is something worth monitoring this week. Prescott has now thrown for 1,639 yards, 10 touchdowns, and five interceptions in six games this season. He will be a low-end QB1 in fantasy in Week 7 vs. the Eagles.

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.title: Tyler Loop scores four points in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Baltimore Ravens kicker Tyler Loop made one of his two field goal attempts and converted his lone PAT in a Week 6 loss against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Loop left three points on the board in what was ultimately a three-point loss, though Cleveland missed a field goal as well. His miss was a 49-yarder early in the fourth quarter. He has struggled from that range, with all three misses this season coming between 40 and 49 yards.

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.title: Andre Szmyt hits game-winner in Week 6
items.desc: Andre Szmyt converted two of his three field goals and his lone PAT attempt in Week 6.
items.impact: Szmyt and the Cleveland Browns have been clutch in fourth quarters; his 37-yarder was his second game-winner this season. Szmyt also converted from 48 in the third quarter, scoring seven points in a 13-0 run after falling behind 10-0.

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.title: Ryan Fitzgerald misses another PAT in Week 6 win
items.desc: Ryan Fitzgerald was 2-for-2 on field goals but 1-for-2 on extra-point attempts in a Week 6 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
items.impact: Fitzgerald is a perfect 11-for-11 on field goals this season - hitting from 47 and 52 yards in Week 6 - but has struggled on PATs. He missed a long point-after following a penalty, and it was his third game with a missed PAT and his fourth total this season, having missed two in Week 5. Special teams was a mixed bag for Carolina.

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.title: Jake Elliott converts both PATs in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Philadelphia Eagles kicker Jake Elliott converted both of his point-after attempts and did not attempt a field goal in a 25-14 Week 6 loss.
items.impact: For the second time this season, Elliott did not attempt a field goal. This season, he has not been heavily involved, attempting multiple field goals only once in six games. Philly's offense has been unreliable, and Elliott has been afforded few opportunities, with little reason to believe that will change soon.

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.title: Makai Lemon inefficient on six targets in Week 6
items.desc: Philadelphia Eagles rookie wide receiver Makai Lemon caught three passes on six targets for 19 yards in Week 6 against Carolina.
items.impact: Lemon had a season-high 43 yards in Week 5 but recorded his lowest yardage output since Week 2. With 4.5 yards per target through six games, Lemon has started slowly in his rookie year. With a backup quarterback taking over, the Eagles' offense could continue to struggle.

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.title: Dontayvion Wicks catches two passes in Week 6
items.desc: Philadelphia Eagles wide receiver Dontayvion Wicks caught two passes for 24 yards in Week 6 against the Carolina Panthers.
items.impact: Wicks had a quiet day after his eight-target outing against Jacksonville in London in Week 5. His four targets were more in line with his season average - he has earned 4-5 in four of six games - but he had a season low in yardage. With Jalen Hurts sidelined, Wicks' role could change going forward.

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.title: Dallas Goedert logs 61 yards in Week 6
items.desc: Philadelphia Eagles tight end Dallas Goedert caught six of his eight targets for 61 yards in a losing effort against the Carolina Panthers.
items.impact: Goedert has been heavily involved since his return from injury. Over the last two weeks, he has had a combined 17 targets. In Week 5, he had an inefficient 38 yards, but he eclipsed 60 yards for the second time in four games played. With Tanner McKee as the starter for the foreseeable future, their chemistry in Week 6 is notable.

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.title: DeVonta Smith finds end zone in Week 6
items.desc: Philadelphia Eagles wide receiver DeVonta Smith caught seven passes for 75 yards and scored a fourth-quarter touchdown in a 25-14 loss to the Carolina Panthers.
items.impact: Smith paced Philly in yards and receptions in Week 6, returning from a two-week absence for a hamstring injury. He has been heavily targeted when on the field, recording 35 targets in his last three games. He also has 50+ yards in every game and has scored twice, giving him a strong floor and weekly upside.

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.title: Dameon Pierce scores in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Philadelphia Eagles running back Dameon Pierce carried the ball 12 times for 35 yards and a score and caught four passes for 15 yards in a loss to the Carolina Panthers.
items.impact: Pierce made his first start since 2023 with Houston. Saquon Barkley is recovering from a hamstring injury, and Tank Bigsby and Will Shipley are both on injured reserve, which could make Pierce the starter for another week or two. He is likely to be a touchdown-dependent FLEX option in an offense missing several pieces, though he dominated the backfield touches in Week 6.

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.title: Tanner McKee throws TD in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Tanner McKee completed 26 of his 45 passes for 215 yards and a score in his first start of the 2026 season.
items.impact: McKee started the third game of his career for Philly and led two scoring drives, tossing one to DeVonta Smith. He has four touchdowns and one turnover in his three starts, while the Eagles average 17 points per game. McKee is expected to remain a starter with Jalen Hurts (blood clot) on injured reserve, but he is a low-end QB2 in fantasy on an offense still finding its identity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Buccaneers D/ST logs five sacks Sunday
items.desc: The Buccaneers D/ST allowed 26 points on 300 total yards with one interception and five sacks on Sunday against the Steelers.
items.impact: The Bucs struggled to contain DK Metcalf and Germie Bernard as they both caught 11 passes on the afternoon. They'll face Bryce Young and the Panthers next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chase McLaughlin makes all four field goals Sunday
items.desc: Chase McLaughlin connected on all four of his field goal attempts.
items.impact: McLaughlin made field goals from 43, 47, 33 and 53 yards away. He is now 14-of-14 on field goals on the season, including 4-of-4 from 50+ yards out.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cade Otton quiet Sunday
items.desc: Cade Otton caught 1-of-2 targets for four yards in the Buccaneers 26-19 loss against the Steelers.
items.impact: Otton remains off the fantasy radar with Jalon Daniels behind center.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ted Hurst III totals 40 yards Sunday
items.desc: Ted Hurst III caught 3-of-6 targets for 40 yards in the Buccaneers 26-19 loss against the Steelers.
items.impact: Hurst continues to act as a field stretcher for the Bucs on the outside. He has been helping their offense, but he remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Godwin Jr. catches four passes Sunday
items.desc: Chris Godwin Jr. caught 4-of-8 targets for 37 yards in the Buccaneers 26-19 loss against the Steelers.
items.impact: Godwin was second on the team in targets, but it didn't result in much production. He remains off the fantasy radar with Jalon Daniels behind center.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Emeka Egbuka sees whopping 16 targets Sunday
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka caught 7-of-16 targets for 48 yards and a touchdown in the Buccaneers 26-19 loss against the Steelers.
items.impact: Egbuka was able to find the end zone for a solid day. It could have been an even bigger day, but Jalon Daniels missed him on some throws. He'll remain a volatile WR2 until Baker Mayfield is healthy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenny Gainwell quiet Sunday
items.desc: Kenny Gainwell ran for 17 yards on two carries in the Buccaneers 26-19 loss against the Steelers. He also caught his lone target for seven yards receiving.
items.impact: Gainwell remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bucky Irving sees 19 carries Sunday
items.desc: Bucky Irving ran for 46 yards on 19 carries in the Buccaneers 26-19 loss against the Steelers. He also caught 2-of-3 targets for three yards receiving.
items.impact: Irving struggled in a much tougher matchup compared to last week. His involvement in the passing game is also limited with Jalon Daniels behind center. He'll remain a touchdown dependent RB2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalon Daniels throws two interceptions Sunday
items.desc: Jalon Daniels completed 22-of-43 passes for 164 yards and one touchdown with two interceptions in the Buccaneers 26-19 loss against the Steelers.
items.impact: After a successful first career start against the Cowboys, it was much tougher in his second start for Daniels. The status of Baker Mayfield for next week remains up in the air.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Steelers D/ST logs two interceptions Sunday
items.desc: The Steelers D/ST allowed 19 points on 224 yards with two interceptions and five sacks on Sunday against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: The Steelers defense made it tough on rookie QB Jalon Daniels all afternoon in the overtime win. They'll face Tyler Shough and the Saints next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Boswell connects on 4-of-5 field goals Sunday
items.desc: Chris Boswell made 4-of-5 field goal attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Boswell made field goals from 52, 39, 58 and 20 yards out. His lone miss came from 48 yards out in the first half.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Darnell Washington finds the end zone Sunday
items.desc: Darnell Washington caught 4-of-6 targets for 25 yards and a touchdown in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Washington saw some more opportunity with Pat Freiermuth dealing with a calf injury. He'll remain a touchdown dependent TE2 heading into next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Pat Freiermuth quiet Sunday
items.desc: Pat Freiermuth caught 2-of-3 targets for 11 yards in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Freiermuth was playing through a calf injury that landed him on the injury report right before Sunday. He'll be more reliable if he can practice fully next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Germie Bernard finds the end zone Sunday
items.desc: Germie Bernard caught 11-of-12 targets for  87 yards and a touchdown in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Bernard took full advantage of his extended opportunity with both Roman Wilson and Michael Pittman Jr. on injured reserve. He scored the wining touchdown in OT as well that he hauled in from Aaron Rodgers. He'll be on the WR3/flex range heading into next week against the Titans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DK Metcalf hauls in 11 passes Sunday
items.desc: DK Metcalf caught 11-of-15 targets for 93 yards in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Metcalf took over late as he totaled 12 targets in the fourth quarter and overtime period alone. He'll remain in the WR2/WR3 range with both Michael Pittman Jr. and Roman Wilson on IR.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rico Dowdle sees seven carries in return Sunday
items.desc: Rico Dowdle ran for 40 yards on seven carries in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers. He also caught 3-of-4 targets for nine yards receiving.
items.impact: Dowdle split the lead role early on before Jaylen Warren took over late in the fourth quarter and overtime period. Dowdle is on the RB3 radar heading into next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylen Warren sees 16 touches Sunday
items.desc: Jaylen Warren ran for 50 yards on 14 carries in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers. He also caught 2-of-4 targets for 28 yards receiving.
items.impact: Warren was the lead back in the Steelers backfield in the fourth quarter and overtime period over Rico Dowdle. He'll remain an RB2 play next week against the Saints.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Aaron Rodgers throws for 253 yards Sunday
items.desc: Aaron Rodgers completed 33-of-49 passes for 253 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Rodgers threw an interception early, but he was able to bounce back and lead the Steelers to an overtime win. He was able to connect 11 times with both DK Metcalf and Germie Bernard. He'll be in the streaming conversation next week against the Saints.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Giants D/ST recovers fumble Sunday
items.desc: The Giants defense allowed 34 points on 319 total yards with a fumble recovery on Sunday against the Saints.
items.impact: The Giants were unable to record any sacks on the day. They'll face CJ Stroud and the Texans next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dominic Zvada makes all three kicks Sunday
items.desc: Dominic Zvada connected on both his field goal attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Zvada made field goals from 34 and 41 yards out on the afternoon.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Isaiah Likely hauls in touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Isaiah Likely caught 6-of-11 targets for 99 yards and a touchdown in the Giants 34-27 loss against the Saints.
items.impact: Likely continued his success at finding the end zone. He nearly caught a second one as J.J. McCarthy just missed looking to find him to tie the game at the end of the game. He remains a locked in TE1.
